description: Send a direct-message reply as the account owner. A REPLY IS SENT AS THE OWNER AND CANNOT BE UNSENT: pass confirm: true only after the owner has approved the exact text; without it, this returns a preview of what would be sent and sends nothing at all. Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, Reddit, Bluesky and Telegram support replying here; TikTok and Threads do not have a reply API on this path, so reply to those in their own app. Needs the separate manage:inbox permission. Take conversationId and accountId from soclo_inbox_list.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list or a prior inbox call.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact text or change. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is sent, nothing is saved.

message.description: The exact text to send, approved by the owner.

name: soclo_inbox_reply
title: Reply to an inbox message
